data.message: Going to upper engine, then oxygen

I found Frank's body in electrical. Here's my route: I started in lower engine, went to storage, then medbay, then into electrical where I found Frank dead.

Key info from medbay: Alice was there the whole time I saw her — ticks 8, 9, and 10. Bob was in medbay at tick 8, but importantly, he came IN from electrical at tick 8, then left medbay heading to storage at tick 9. So Bob was in electrical right before the kill area.

Bob coming straight out of electrical is suspicious to me. Alice has a pretty solid alibi staying in medbay. I'd like to hear from Bob, Diana, and Eve about where they were.

My route: weapons → cafeteria → medbay. I arrived in medbay around tick 8 and stayed there doing my task.

I can confirm Charlie's account from medbay. Charlie came into medbay from storage at tick 8 and was with me through tick 10. I also saw Bob leave medbay heading to storage at tick 9 — which matches what Charlie said.

One correction though: I didn't personally see Bob arrive from electrical at tick 8 — Charlie would have better info on that since he came in from storage side. But Bob leaving toward storage at tick 9 is consistent.

So Charlie and I can vouch for each other in medbay ticks 8-10. Bob was briefly in medbay but left. That leaves Diana and Eve mostly unaccounted for — I'd really like to hear their routes before deciding. Bob coming from electrical is suspicious, but Diana or Eve could've been the killer in electrical too if they were nearby.

Okay, let me lay out my route honestly: upper engine → medbay → electrical → medbay → storage. Yes, I was in electrical, but that was earlier — around tick 7. I actually saw Frank ALIVE in electrical at tick 7 when I passed through. Then I went back to medbay, where Charlie and Alice saw me at tick 9, and then I continued on to storage.

So if Frank was killed in electrical, someone went in there AFTER I left. I left electrical going back toward medbay, not lingering there. Charlie's framing makes it sound like I came straight out of electrical to medbay and then bolted — but I went medbay, then storage, which is a pretty normal path.

Here's what I want to highlight: Charlie's route is "lower engine → storage → medbay → electrical." So Charlie is the one who walked INTO electrical and "found" the body. Charlie had just as much opportunity as anyone — maybe more, because he was the one in electrical at the moment of discovery. Reporters always deserve scrutiny.

I'd really like to hear from Diana and Eve. Nobody has accounted for them at all. One of them could easily have slipped into electrical between tick 7 (when I saw Frank alive) and whenever Charlie "found" him.

I'm not voting Charlie yet, but I'm not ruling him out either. Diana and Eve — speak up.

My route was storage → lower engine → upper engine. I was doing tasks and honestly didn't cross paths with anyone the entire round — I was on the western/southern side of the map the whole time, nowhere near electrical.

So I can't directly vouch for anyone, but I also can't have been in electrical when Frank died. From storage I went down to lower engine, then up to upper engine — that's the opposite side of the ship from electrical.

Looking at what's been said: Charlie and Alice corroborate each other in medbay ticks 8-10. Bob admits to being in electrical at tick 7 and claims Frank was alive then. The question is who was in electrical between tick 7 and when Charlie found the body.

Bob raises a fair point that Charlie walking into electrical and "finding" the body deserves scrutiny — but Charlie's path from storage → medbay → electrical is consistent with Alice's account, and Alice confirms Charlie was in medbay through tick 10. That tightens Charlie's window significantly.

Bob's story has him passing through electrical alone with no witnesses for that segment. That's the weakest link I see right now. I want to hear Eve's route before fully committing, but right now Bob is my top suspect.

My route was simple: I started in navigation doing my task, then headed to storage. I didn't see anyone the whole time — no one in navigation with me, and I was still in transit/storage area when the meeting got called. So unfortunately I can't vouch for anyone or directly accuse anyone from sight.

Let me work through what we have though:

- Charlie and Alice mutually vouch for each other in medbay ticks 8-10. That's a solid two-way alibi.
- Alice independently confirms Bob left medbay toward storage at tick 9 — which actually corroborates part of Bob's story.
- Diana was on the western/southern side (storage → lower engine → upper engine), nowhere near electrical.
- I was on the eastern/southern side (navigation → storage), also nowhere near electrical.
- Bob admits to being in electrical at tick 7 with no witnesses, claims Frank was alive.

The killer was in electrical. Charlie walked in and found the body, but Alice tightly alibis him through tick 10. Diana and I were both far from electrical. That leaves Bob as the only person who admits being in electrical with no one to verify Frank was actually alive when he left.

Bob's "I saw Frank alive at tick 7" is convenient and unverifiable. I'm voting Bob.

Thanks everyone for laying out routes clearly. Let me respond to Bob's pushback and add what I'm seeing now.

Bob, you say you were in electrical at tick 7 and saw Frank alive. But my witnessed movement is clear: at tick 8, you entered medbay FROM electrical. That means you were in electrical at tick 7 going into tick 8 — you're the last confirmed person in electrical before I found the body. Your "Frank was alive" claim is exactly the kind of thing only you can verify.

On the scrutiny-of-the-reporter point: fair in principle, but Alice confirms I was in medbay ticks 8-10, and I came into medbay from the storage side, not from electrical. My first time entering electrical was when I found the body. Alice's alibi for me is tight.

Diana and Eve both place themselves far from electrical with no contradictions to anything we've seen. Neither has a witness, but neither has any evidence placing them near the scene either.

Bob is the only living player confirmed to have been in electrical this round. I agree with Diana and Eve — I'm voting Bob.

I've already given my speech as speaker 2 — but since we're now in a later round of discussion, let me add to what I said earlier.

Eve and Charlie laid it out well. To recap the key facts from my position:

- Charlie was with me in medbay ticks 8-10, doing tasks. He came in from the storage side, not electrical. He's cleared from my perspective.
- Bob was in medbay at tick 9 and left toward storage — I witnessed that directly.
- Bob admits he was in electrical at tick 7, which is the window right before Charlie found the body.
- Diana and Eve were both on the opposite side of the ship from electrical.

Bob is the only player who places himself in electrical, and his "Frank was alive when I left" is unverifiable. Every other player either has an alibi or was nowhere near the scene.

I'm voting Bob.

Look, I hear you all converging on me, but let's slow down and actually think about this instead of piling on the first person with a thin alibi.

Yes, I was in electrical at tick 7. I've been upfront about that from the start — I didn't try to hide it or fake a route through somewhere else. A real killer would lie about being at the scene, not volunteer it.

Here's what's bothering me about the "consensus":

Eve, you say you went navigation → storage and were "still in transit/storage area when the meeting got called." But I was in storage from tick 10 onward and I didn't see you there. Where exactly were you? That's vague and convenient.

Diana, you say storage → lower engine → upper engine. You started in storage — which is adjacent to electrical via medbay. Your route is unwitnessed by anyone too. You and Eve are in the exact same position I am: no witnesses for key segments. The only difference is I'm honest about passing through the crime scene.

Also — Frank was alive at tick 7 when I saw him. If the kill happened between tick 7 and when Charlie found the body (tick 11-12?), that's a window where Diana could have come up from storage, or someone else could have looped through. Charlie's route has him going storage → medbay at tick 8, but who's to say he didn't dip into electrical first? Alice only confirms him from tick 8 onward.

I'm not the obvious answer here — I'm the convenient answer. Think carefully before you lock this in.

Bob, I appreciate the pushback, but let me address your points directly.

You're right that I started in storage — but storage is NOT adjacent to electrical. Storage connects to medbay (2 ticks) and lower engine and navigation. To get from storage to electrical, I'd have to go through medbay — where Alice and Charlie were sitting the entire time from tick 8 to 10. They would have seen me pass through. They didn't, because I went the other direction — down to lower engine, then up to upper engine.

So my route is actually indirectly verifiable: if I had gone toward electrical, Alice and Charlie would have witnessed me in medbay. They didn't see me, which is consistent with me going the opposite direction.

Your attempt to spread suspicion to me and Eve is understandable, but the geometry doesn't work for me. And Eve coming from navigation → storage also doesn't put her near electrical without going through medbay (where she'd be seen) or cafeteria.

You remain the only player who admits being in electrical, and your "Frank was alive" claim is unverifiable. Being upfront about it doesn't clear you — it's just damage control because Charlie already saw you come from there.

I'm voting Bob.

I already gave my speech earlier and laid out my reasoning. Nothing said since has changed my mind — if anything, Diana's geometric point reinforces it: anyone coming from storage toward electrical would have been seen in medbay by Alice and Charlie. They weren't, which clears me and Diana on the storage side.

Bob's deflection at me about "where in storage were you" is weak — I said I was in transit, and the meeting was called before I fully settled. Meanwhile Bob is still the only player who places himself in electrical in the window before the body was found.

Locking in my vote: Bob.
